scope: Full-world physical and CPU raster evidence is retained. Final source is independently production-compiled and runs real main startup, actual Renderer, Settings off/on, and night guards. Exact inverse source reconstruction recovers the byte-identical prior production bundle, proving no other compiled module changed.
allowedDeltas: CharacterSystem retains lastFailure and clears active lastError after a successful enabled update.
CharacterManager extracts the unchanged rollout expression into a read-only getter; CharacterSystem.statusSnapshot includes it.
unchanged: character placements, registry and world configuration
boundaries: CPU integration only. No full-frame WebGL, device performance, pixel-perfect texture, lighting, or historical acceptance.
